name: Scarlet Witch

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Coldsnap: Ani soğuk hasarı verir ve düşmanın Kaçış yeteneğini kapatır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Sting: Rakip özel saldırı attığında yüksek şok hasarı almasını sağlar.

signatureAbility:
Organized Chaos
Against Cosmic, Mystic, Tech Opponents: 20% chance per Instability to inflict a Petrify or Armor Break Debuff for 3 seconds.
Against Cosmic, Mutant, Skill Opponents: 20% chance per Instability to inflict a Power Sting or Heal Block Debuff for 3 seconds.
Petrify of [40 - 100]% Potency.
Armor Break: reducing Armor by [687.48 - 1,833.33].
Power Sting: Deal [6,922.14 - 13,844.4] direct damage on activation of Opponents Special Attacks.
Heal Block: Stopping all healing effects.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.

abilitySections.title: Instability
content: On Special Activation, gain 1 indefinite Instability. 1 Instability is removed when knocked down by a Special Attack.
If 6+ Instability are active for 10 seconds, inflict Opponent with Degeneration, dealing [34,611] Direct Damage over 6 seconds.
When the above Degeneration expires, remove all Instability.

abilitySections.title: Chaos Surge
content: Every 4 seconds, activate Chaos Surge, granting both Champions a 20% chance per Instability to gain 1 randomly selected Buff. Small chance to grant all Buffs.
Armor Up: granting +[1,480.77] Armor Rating for 12 seconds.
Fury: granting +[5,768.5] Attack Rating for 12 seconds.
Cruelty: granting +[305.56] Critical Damage Rating over 12 seconds.
Prowess: granting 120% Special Attack Damage for 12 seconds.
Unblockable: lasting 4 seconds.
Buffs are not granted to Champions launching Special Attacks.
If Scarlet Witch Nullifies any Armor Up, Fury, Cruelty, Prowess, or Unblockable Buffs, she gains her matching Chaos Surge Buff.

abilitySections.title: Before The Opponent Lands an Attack
content: While blocking, 15% chance to Nullify 1 Buff. Increased to 100% during the Well-Timed Block window.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Consume 1 Instability to create a non-stacking Power Gain Buff, generating 100% of a Bar of Power over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The first successful hit creates 1 Instability.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit inflicts a Random Debuff. Duration is increased by 20% for each Buff on either Champion. Max 100%.
Poison, dealing [18,459.2] Direct Damage over 10 seconds. Poison also reduces the Opponents Regeneration Rate by 30%.
Inflicts Coldsnap, dealing [18,459.2] Energy Damage over 10 seconds.
Incinerate, dealing [18,459.2] Energy Damage over 10 seconds. Incinerate also prevents the activation of Perfect Block and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Nullify up to 5 Buffs on the Opponent. Each Buff Nullified this way increases this attacks Attack Rating by [3,461.1].
Remove all Instabilities, each inflicting a Passive Degeneration dealing [31,726.75] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.
